data.name: Drift Mania
data.detailed_description:
Drift Only. No Brakes. No Mercy.

DriftMania is a competitive drift-only time attack game built for players who want to chase ghosts, grind leaderboards, and fight for the perfect run.

Your car accelerates automatically. There are no brakes. Steering means drifting. Hit a wall and the run is over.

Every corner is a risk. Every line can be cleaner. Every mistake costs the run.

Master 60 Handcrafted Tracks

Take on a 60-level campaign built around pure drift control. Learn each route, carry speed through tight corners, and push for faster times as the tracks demand cleaner lines and sharper commitment.

Race Ghosts. Climb Leaderboards.

Compete for global leaderboard times on every track.

Race your personal best ghost, chase the next rank above you, or pick any leaderboard ghost and challenge their run directly. The goal is simple: climb higher, go faster, and take the number one spot.

Build And Share Your Own Tracks

Create your own drift challenges with the built-in level editor and share them with the community.

Build technical routes, flowing drift lines, or brutal challenge tracks made for leaderboard competition. Play community-made levels and keep chasing new times beyond the campaign.

Customize Your Garage

Earn rewards based on your times and spend them in the garage.

Unlock car skins, tire tracks, tires, car parts, and new car models. Cosmetics are visual, but your times decide what you earn.

Features

  • Drift-only time attack racing

  • Auto acceleration and no brakes

  • One wall hit ends the run

  • 60 handcrafted campaign tracks

  • Global online leaderboards

  • Personal best, next-rank, and leaderboard ghosts

  • Pick any leaderboard ghost and race against it

  • Built-in level editor

  • Share and play community-made tracks

  • Garage customization with skins, tire tracks, tires, parts, and car models

  • Playable with keyboard or controller

data.short_description: No brakes. No reverse. Just drift control. Master short precision courses, chase ghosts and leaderboards, build custom tracks, and turn messy attempts into clean time-attack runs.
